tei:div.tei:p: 229) dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi sgo nas tshe 'das la phan btags pa'-i 'dul gyi phrin las sbyor tshul bzhugs/ bla ma dang ngag gi dbang po la phyag 'tshal loḥ gtor zlog dang sbrel na de'i chas dang drag po'i sbyin sreg gi shoms/ 'dul dkar gnas lung zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba gzhan phan thugs rje'i drwa ba 'di rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dgongs pa bdun tshig gzhan las lhag par gsungs pas de sbyor tshul la pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng bum pa bcud ldan a bzhis mtshan pa mchod pa brgya rtsas bskor/ sbyong cha sogs kyang 'du byas nas rang gzhung bzlas pa grub pa dang*/ shu n+ya ta bum pa 'od lnga'i sogs skyed zlas mchod bstod 'od zhu bcas bya/ bka' srung rjes na rag skong bshags/ tshogs byin rlabs nas lhag ma yan grub pa dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg kha bsgyur gsham gsal ltar btang*/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dbang chen rdo rje gro lod du gsal ba sogs kha sgyur/ tshogs ltar ram rig me dor/ gnang ba zhu/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma sogs nas rten bskyed 'gugs pa bcom ldan 'das dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi lha tshogs zhes pa kha sgyur/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbar me chu til gsum bshams la gri khrol a rā ga'i gsung ni tshe 'das rnam shes a 230) yig dkar po deḥ hṛ yig sngo skya k+ṣa yig dmar skya yiḥ drwa bas rus pa spags pa'i tshul du btumasaḥ bdag gi thugs las hūṃ yig dkar po dngaḥ phaṭaḥyig dmar po dpag med 'phros pa yisaḥ hṛ dang k+ṣa yi drwa ba dngos med 'dzigaḥ til me chu dar/ a hṛ k+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ཿ brgya rtsa rjod/ dkon mchog gsum dang rdo rje gro lod kyiḥ bden pa chen pos tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi: 'chi kha'i mtshams sbyor skrag snang 'ur 'jigs kyi: bag chags ngan pa'i gri gcags bral gyur cig sor bsnol phyir dral/ oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha tra thaḥ a badz+ra bhid tra thaḥ las ngags ming byang bran/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭaḥ

me chu dor ba lan gsum bskor/ oṃ badz+ra bhid tra thaḥ ces phyir dor/ dri gos mtshan byang tshe 'das lus su gsalaḥ pra we sha ya phaṭa ces lus sgo phyesaḥ nṛ ཿa be sha ya a zhes brjod pa yisaḥ rnam par shes pa a yig dngul chu'i mdogaḥ lus la zhugs pas tshe 'das 231) dngos gyur pa'iḥ snying gar ye shes rdo rje rtse lnga paḥ lte bar hūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan pa laḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmi 'gyur rgyas btab gyuraḥ lus la rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lubs su bkon par gyuraḥ oṃ badz+ra ka la sha rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: spyi bor rdo rje gzhag phyi rol rdo rje'i gyur chen por gyur: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes rjod/ oṃ sarba big+naṃ sogs nas sbyong khrus dbang bskur phung khams skye mched yi'i dam lha yi ngo bor dag par gyuraḥ zhes pa'i 'phros su oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ'agro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lngaḥ sogs kyis 'dod yon bsngo/ kyai tshe las 'das pa gson cigaḥsogs nas/ ma sngangs ma skrag par song zhigaḥ rjes su bzang spyod sogs kyi smon lam gdab/ gtor zlog man 'phang ba'i las rim ltar bya/ nub tha mar lam bstan rjes su/ byang bu'i rnam shes hūm̐ gi rnam pas zhing khams de dag tu gshegs par gyur/ ming byang sreg pa ni/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi buḥ phung po lnga yi bud shing laḥ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar roḥ 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing 232) laḥ lha mo bzhi yi me sbar roḥ dbang po drug gi bud shing laḥ byang chub sems kyi me sbar roḥ yul rnam drug gi bud shing laḥ rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar roḥ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan duḥ 'gro ba'i don gnyis grub par shogaḥ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ra dz+wa la raṃḥ zhes phung po sbyong thabs sgrib gnyis rnam grol las 'byung bas bsregs la sāts+tsha gdab po/ zhes pa'ang dpal chen 'dus pas so/ dge'o//
